visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a dark blue sweater driving a white Mercedes-Benz convertible along a sandy shoreline. The sea is to his left, and he laughs while shielding his face from splashing seawater. (2) A mobile interface showing a ChatGPT conversation is presented, with a hand scrolling through a list of scenic driving spots in Japan, specifically highlighting Chirihama Nagisa Driveway. (3) A montage follows showing the car driving on an asphalt highway next to the ocean under a cloudy sky. The camera captures the side mirror and the view through the front windshield. (4) The scene shifts to a rainy drive with active wipers, showing the man looking slightly frustrated inside the cabin. (5) The rain stops and the car transitions onto a wide sandy beach where other vehicles are parked. The man is seen smiling while steering on the sand. (6) Several wide shots show the car parked near the water's edge and the man standing by the vehicle looking out at the horizon. The video concludes with a still-frame 'photo' of the car on the beach.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我在日本自駕聽了AI的建議 最後不小心把車開下海!. [Variety]: (被海水潑到). (2) [Subtitle]: 自駕穿越日本的企劃. (3) [Subtitle]: 出發前我問AI有哪些景點. (4) [Subtitle]: 是適合開車去 又適合拍照讓車子入鏡的. (5) [Subtitle]: 它推薦了一個點叫 千里濱沙道道路 (石川). [Slogan]: 日本少數「可以直接把車開在沙灘上」. 海浪就在旁邊. 神級畫面: 車+海+浪. 日落時車影倒映在濕沙上. ! 下雨天避免, 沙子會軟. (6) [Subtitle]: 是全日本唯一一個 可以開車下去的沙灘. 位在台灣人很少聽過的石川縣. (7) [Subtitle]: 對於開車下海這件事情 我其實是半信半疑的. 但如果被AI騙 我覺得也會很好笑. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以呢就決定開過去看看. 結果路上還下著大雨. (9) [Subtitle]: 我心想這種天氣 就算可以開車下海 也會很狼狽吧. 沒想到抵達前的最後一刻 雨停了. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後過了一個堤防 沒有任何阻攔 真的可以把車開上海灘. 而且不只我 同時有好幾台車 就這樣開在海灘上欣賞海景. (11) [Subtitle]: 我人生也第一次體會到 在海邊開敞篷車. 然後又被自己濺起來的海水 噴到臉上. (12) [Subtitle]: 原本還擔心 車子會不會陷在沙裡 但完全不會. 最後我甚至可以把車停在海邊 看著日本海拍照. (13) [Subtitle]: 各位如果有機會 自駕在石川附近的話呢 一定要過來看看.
